---
title: "Editable figures: a synthetic example"
params:
  participants: 60
output: html_document
---

## Two groups

This example uses deterministic simulated values, not participant data.

```{r prepare}
study <- data.frame(
  condition = factor(rep(c("Group A", "Group B"), length.out = params$participants)),
  score = sin(seq_len(params$participants)) +
    rep(c(0, .5), length.out = params$participants)
)
```

```{r group-comparison}
comparison <- jmv::ANOVA(data = study, dep = "score", factors = "condition")
comparison
```
